# 2 Baruch Chapter 52 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**52:1** And-I-answered and-said: "How-can-it-be? That-they-who-do-good works-will-see that-the-reward-of-their-works is-not-in-vain?"

**52:2** "And-moreover, how-will-this-transformation of-which-you-speak-to-me come-to-pass?"

**52:3** And-he-answered and-said-to-me: "Those-who-are-in-darkness will-pass-away, and-those-who-are-in-light will-endure."

**52:4** "For-as-many-as-have-been-saved by-their-works will-return and-not-be-disquieted; and-they-will-not-be-ashamed on-account-of-their-works."

**52:5** "But-those-who-have-neglected-the-law and-who-have-not-heard wisdom and-who-have-not-received understanding — those-shall-know the-torment-of-the-hour."

**52:6** "For-they-shall-see those-who-are-superior-to-them, and-they-shall-not-be-equal-to-them; and-they-shall-receive-shameful-things, that-they-may-be-tormented."

**52:7** "For-those-who-were-saved in-that-day will-enter-into-the-joy-of-their-king, and-they-will-be-like-unto-angels in-appearance."

**52:8** "But-those-who-were-not-saved will-depart in-confusion, and-they-will-be-ashamed; for-a-law will-be-judgment-upon-them, and-a-deed will-stand-as-a-witness."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
